messages:
sam-docs: Quick hit from yesterday's onboarding run: the top-of-readme snippets have a few small but recurring footguns. CURL uses REDWOOD_KEY, Node shows ESM-only `import fetch from 'node-fetch'` which breaks in lots of starter apps, and the Go example calls `client.GenerateSync()` which no longer exists in v1.5.

ara-sdk: thanks for flagging. the env var rename landed ages ago; docs must have missed one copy. which file path?

sam-docs: docs/quickstart/README.md (top). I opened a tiny PR with three changes: canonicalize to REDWOOD_API_KEY, add a PowerShell-safe curl, and provide both an ESM and a CommonJS Node snippet so users can pick.

jon-support: huge help. 50% of our new-user 401 tickets are from this mismatch. Also can we include a 1-line note: "SDKs implement retries/backoff by default; the curl examples are one-shot". saves a follow-up ticket every week.

alice-devex: yep — please also add a tiny callout for Node runtimes: "If you run Node <18, use the CommonJS snippet (requires node-fetch@2); Node 18+ can use global fetch or the ESM snippet."

sam-docs: pasted the two Node snippets for quick review:

```js
// Node (CommonJS) - works on Node 12+ with node-fetch@2
const fetch = require('node-fetch'); // npm i node-fetch@2
const API_KEY = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;
fetch('https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${API_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Hello' })
})
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(console.log)
  .catch(err => console.error('request failed', err));
```

```js
// Node (ESM / Node 18+) - uses global fetch
const API_KEY = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${API_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Hello' })
});
console.log(await res.json());
```

sam-docs: and the PowerShell-safe curl since we keep getting PS interpolation bugs:

```pwsh
# PowerShell - avoids header interpolation
curl -Method POST -Uri 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate' -Headers @{ 'Authorization' = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" } -Body (ConvertTo-Json @{ prompt = 'Hello' })
```

ara-sdk: LGTM. i'll also open a tiny change in the Go SDK docs to update the constructor and remove GenerateSync references; plus i'll add a note in the SDK changelog to remind maintainers to update quickstart snippets when we change public method names.

jon-support: can we add copy buttons to the code blocks too? that reduces bad pastes a lot.

alice-devex: filing a docs-ui follow-up to add copy buttons and a runtime selector on the quickstart page (desktop only for now). also adding a checklist item for SE onboarding so they point to the updated snippet during first-run tests.

sam-docs: PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1120 — small and backwards-compatible.

render-bot: docs site rebuild scheduled (job 10497). ETA ~ 9m.

jon-support: thanks team 47d; i'll watch for rebuild and then bulk-close the related support tickets.

sam-docs: closing after merge. thanks all.
